india tech news.title: Swiggy shareholders approve 49.5% foreign ownership cap, clearing path to IOCC status
india tech news.note: AGM resolution passed with 99.99% backing, clearing Swiggy's transition to an Indian-owned-and-controlled company and opening the door to an inventory-led Instamart model.

india tech news.title: Nikhil Kamath, Sreeram Reddy Vanga invest Rs 250 crore in CtrlS Datacenters
india tech news.note: Zerodha co-founder Kamath and entrepreneur Vanga back the Hyderabad-based hyperscale data-centre operator's capacity expansion as AI and cloud demand grows.

india tech news.title: NeoGeo raises $20 Mn Series A led by Neev II Fund and Aavishkaar Capital
india tech news.note: Gurugram-based geospatial intelligence startup NeoGeoInfo Technologies will use the round for R&D, international expansion and product development.

india tech news.title: Shiprocket shares make a solid debut, list at 35% premium over IPO price
india tech news.note: The logistics aggregator's Rs 1,617-crore IPO, subscribed nearly 100 times, listed strongly on NSE and BSE, pushing market cap to about Rs 9,422 crore.

india tech news.title: India's semiconductor ecosystem set for expansion, 5-6 projects may go live by 2026-end: MeitY Secy S Krishnan
india tech news.note: MeitY Secretary S Krishnan said several approved fab and ATMP projects remain on track for commercial production by year-end.

india tech news.title: Semicon India 2026 to showcase chip ecosystem, feature global CEOs
india tech news.note: Preview of the fifth Semicon India conference, scheduled for September 17-19 in Delhi with PM Modi expected to inaugurate.

india tech news.title: ISRO set to end seven-month launch freeze with GISAT-1A in September
india tech news.note: The GSLV-launched earth-observation satellite will be ISRO's first mission since the PSLV-C62/EOS-N1 failure in January.

india tech news.title: Jio Prime membership offers tariff price protection as it eyes Airtel subscribers
india tech news.note: Analysts frame the new Rs 300 one-time Jio Prime membership as a response to Airtel's tariff rationalisation and a bid to retain subscribers ahead of expected hikes.

india tech news.title: Ant Group sells 3% Paytm stake in $309 million deal
india tech news.note: A block deal worth roughly Rs 2,949 crore saw Ant-linked Resilient Asset Management trim its holding in the Indian fintech.

india tech news.title: Perplexity's free AI offer left it with millions more users in India
india tech news.note: Perplexity's India mobile revenue and user base have grown sharply this year as it competes with OpenAI and Google for the market.

india tech news.title: Your next Zomato order could cost 10-30% more as sustainable packaging shift looms
india tech news.note: Zomato's chief sustainability officer says moving away from plastic packaging needs wider scale before costs can come down for consumers.

global tech news.title: China's backflipping robot maker Unitree pops in Shanghai debut
global tech news.note: Unitree shares surged as much as 629% intraday on its STAR Market debut, becoming the first listed humanoid-robot maker in mainland China at close to a $66B valuation.

global tech news.title: Meta trial that could reshape Facebook and Instagram gets underway
global tech news.note: A bipartisan 29-state coalition opened a six-week federal trial in Oakland alleging Meta designed Instagram/Facebook to addict young users; Meta pegs potential penalties near $1.4T.

global tech news.title: Etched's valuation doubles to $21B in a month
global tech news.note: AI inference-chip startup raised $700M led by Jane Street (with Kleiner Perkins, Sequoia, a16z, Tiger Global and others), taking total funding to $1.9B.

global tech news.title: Apple plugs image-processing hole ripe for spyware abuse
global tech news.note: Apple patched CVE-2026-65346, a critical ImageIO integer-overflow bug (found by Meta's Red Team) that could enable zero-click code execution via a malicious image, across iOS/iPadOS/macOS.

global tech news.title: OpenAI Is Slowing Down Its AI Training
global tech news.note: Sam Altman told TIME 'it's a good time to slow down,' saying OpenAI is pausing frontier-model training after research showed signs of misalignment as capabilities advanced faster than expected.

global tech news.title: OpenAI seeks to one-up Anthropic with new customer privacy protections
global tech news.note: OpenAI is previewing 'Private Safety Processing' with early customers, a tool that flags cross-session misuse patterns (e.g. split-up cyberattack planning) while preserving zero data retention; broad launch planned for September.

global tech news.title: China's LandSpace lands reusable rocket booster, closing the gap with SpaceX
global tech news.note: LandSpace recovered the first stage of its Zhuque-3 rocket, becoming the third private company after SpaceX and Blue Origin to land an orbital-class booster.

global tech news.title: Samsung raises advanced foundry prices by up to 15% as AI demand fills its 4nm lines
global tech news.note: Samsung hiked SF4/SF5/8nm order prices 5-15% in July as TSMC's leading-edge capacity fills up on AI-chip demand; Chinese customers reportedly accepted the steepest increases.

global tech news.title: First Nvidia H200 shipments reach China as ByteDance and Tencent take deliveries
global tech news.note: ByteDance and Tencent reportedly each received about 10,000 Nvidia H200 chips as Beijing eases its import block, though most licensed units must stay in Hong Kong for now.

global tech news.title: CISA gives feds 3 days to fix actively exploited Ray RCE bug
global tech news.note: CISA added a code-injection flaw in Ray, the open-source distributed-computing framework used by Amazon, Apple and OpenAI for ML workloads, to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

global tech news.title: Z.ai launches GLM-5.3 with claimed 50% gain on coding benchmark
global tech news.note: Zhipu's international brand shipped GLM-5.3, targeting coding agents, tool use and defensive cybersecurity work; open-weights release promised two weeks later.

global tech news.title: Pony.ai's overseas robotaxi pipeline tops 4,000 vehicles
global tech news.note: Pipeline includes a 2,000+ vehicle Uber deployment deal in Europe plus services in Luxembourg, Singapore and Croatia; Q2 robotaxi revenue surged 691% year over year.

global tech news.title: Stock Market Today (Aug. 19, 2026): S&P 500 rises despite tech weakness as health care, cyclicals jump
global tech news.note: Chip and tech stocks lagged the broader market amid rising bond yields, days ahead of Nvidia's August 26 earnings report.

global tech news.title: ByteDance and Hollywood reach agreement over AI video IP rights
global tech news.note: The Motion Picture Association's first-ever AI-company deal adds copyright guardrails to ByteDance's Seedance video and Seedream image-generation models, months after an MPA cease-and-desist letter.

global tech news.title: Baidu Q2 2026 earnings miss as ad revenue falls 19%
global tech news.note: Net profit plunged 68% year over year to roughly $341.6M even as AI cloud infrastructure revenue grew 50%; fifth straight quarter of revenue decline.

global tech news.title: Xiaomi's profit drops again as the memory crunch squeezes its phones
global tech news.note: Adjusted net profit fell roughly 43% as soaring memory-chip costs from the global AI-driven shortage hit smartphone margins; third straight quarterly profit decline.

global tech news.title: Perplexity's free AI offer left it with millions more users in India
global tech news.note: Giving free premium access to Airtel's 360M customers pushed Perplexity's India in-app revenue well above its 2026 average, per the company's growth data.
